questions.quote: Find out the part that is not found in CPU? a. Mother Board b. SMPS c. RAM d. Mouse

en.q: Which of the following is not found inside the CPU cabinet?
en.explanation: The mouse is an input device connected from outside.

ta.explanation: சுட்டி வெளியிலிருந்து இணைக்கப்படும் உள்ளீட்டுச் சாதனம். (மேலும்: மவுஸ்.)

questions.quote: LINUX is a a. Paid Software b. Licensed Software c. Free and Proprietary software d. Free and Open source software

en.explanation: Examples of free and open source software: Linux, Open Office, Geogebra.

ta.explanation: லினக்ஸ், ஓபன் ஆஃபீஸ், ஜியோஜீப்ரா திறந்த மூல மென்பொருள்கள்.

questions.quote: Find out Paid and Proprietary software from the given list a. Windows b. MAC OS c. Adobe Photoshop d. All the above

en.q: Which of the following is a paid and proprietary software?
options: Linux and Open Office – both of them
Windows, MAC OS and Photoshop – all of them
Geogebra and Linux – both of them
Open Office and Geogebra – both of them
en.explanation: Windows, Microsoft Office and Adobe Photoshop are paid and proprietary.

ta.explanation: விண்டோஸ், மைக்ரோசாஃப்ட் ஆஃபீஸ், அடோபி ஃபோட்டோஷாப் கட்டணமுள்ளவை.

questions.quote: ______ is a Operating System a. Android b. Chrome c. Internet d. Pendrive

en.q: Hardware and Software: Which of the following is an operating system?
en.explanation: Linux, Windows, Mac and Android are popular operating systems.

ta.explanation: லினக்ஸ், விண்டோஸ், மேக், ஆண்ட்ராய்டு பிரபலமான இயக்க முறைமைகள்.

questions.quote: What do you mean by Operating System? How it Works?

en.q: Without the ______, the computer cannot function on its own.
en.explanation: The operating system makes hardware devices process the data inputted by the user and display the result on output devices.

ta.explanation: இயக்க முறைமை பயனர் உள்ளிடும் தரவை வன்பொருள் செயலாக்கி முடிவை வெளியீட்டுச் சாதனத்தில் காட்டச் செய்கிறது.

questions.quote: What is Free and Open Source Software? Give any two examples?

en.q: Free and open source software is ______.
options: protected by a heavy licence fee
not editable by any of its users
free of cost; can be edited and shared
available only on payment of a price
